items.title: John Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Bunny Berigan? [INTERVIEWEE] No, the tap dancer.

ctx.x: Wow. You’ve had an amazing life.

Well I would say that it’s great, wonderful. And it’s still amazing. It seems to be getting bigger and bigger. It doesn’t end. And all I did was, at the time when I was looking for employment I was trying to survive. And I’ll tell you one thing. This thing about becoming the world’s greatest bass player. One night I was on stage with Barney Briggs — Bunny.
